def main(ratings, rounds, results):
    n = len(ratings)
    score = [0] * n
    played = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    opps = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    whites = [0] * n
    last = [None] * n
    had_bye = [False] * n
    rematches = 0
    ri = 0
    for _ in range(rounds):
        rank = sorted(range(n), key=lambda p: (-score[p], -ratings[p], p))
        pool = list(rank)
        if n % 2 == 1:
            for p in reversed(rank):
                if not had_bye[p]:
                    had_bye[p] = True
                    score[p] += 2
                    pool.remove(p)
                    break
        unpaired = pool
        pairs = []
        while unpaired:
            a = unpaired.pop(0)
            b = None
            for q in unpaired:
                if q not in played[a]:
                    b = q
                    break
            if b is None:
                b = unpaired[0]
                rematches += 1
            unpaired.remove(b)
            if whites[a] < whites[b]:
                w, bl = a, b
            elif whites[b] < whites[a]:
                w, bl = b, a
            else:
                a_black = last[a] == 'b'
                b_black = last[b] == 'b'
                if a_black and not b_black:
                    w, bl = a, b
                elif b_black and not a_black:
                    w, bl = b, a
                else:
                    w, bl = a, b
            pairs.append((w, bl))
        for (w, bl) in pairs:
            r = results[ri]
            ri += 1
            if r == 0:
                score[w] += 2
            elif r == 1:
                score[w] += 1
                score[bl] += 1
            else:
                score[bl] += 2
            whites[w] += 1
            last[w] = 'w'
            last[bl] = 'b'
            played[w].add(bl)
            played[bl].add(w)
            opps[w].append(bl)
            opps[bl].append(w)
    buch = [sum(score[o] for o in opps[p]) for p in range(n)]
    ranking = sorted(range(n), key=lambda p: (-score[p], -buch[p], -ratings[p], p))
    return (score, buch, ranking, whites, rematches)
